title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Closing-Month Terms for Employers Moving to a Payroll Card Program
content:
**Clause.** An employer moving its payees to a Paystride Payroll Card Program, shown by a program in contracted status signed fewer than 3 whole months before the closing date, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's, earns 20 percent on the closing-month fee of its Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service, an employer whose Payroll Card Program is live earns 10 percent, and any other employer earns no migration percentage. This migration percentage applies to the closing-month fee only; on the platform fee of a completed billing month, holding a Payroll Card Program earns no discount.

The program's status and its signed date are read from the employer's Paystride Payroll Card Program record.

## Migration percentage

| The employer's Paystride Payroll Card Program | Percentage on the closing-month fee |
|---|---|
| in contracted status, signed fewer than 3 whole months before the closing date | 20 percent |
| live | 10 percent |
| any other case | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, closure on the 15th of a month)

- A contracted program signed on the 16th of the month three calendar months earlier: 2 whole months, fewer than 3, so 20 percent.
- A contracted program signed on the 15th of the month three calendar months earlier: 3 whole months, not fewer than 3, so the contracted percentage does not apply.
- An employer with no Payroll Card Program, or one whose program is suspended or terminated: no migration percentage.
